plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.227-229. History and Religion majors must earn a C or better in all of their major courses, as printed. Neither a history minor nor a religion minor is an option for this major, though any other minor in the curriculum may be pursued, as printed. History and Religion majors can earn a total of eight hours of internship credit in their major; the eight internship hours must be divided equally across fields, four in HIS and four in REP, as printed. A combined concentration in history and religion is not available within the liberal studies major, as printed.
